RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "We need improve parent." / "We can design robust IPD strategy" / "We can write strategy."
STRATEGY: Parent is a TFT-like strategy with forgiveness after two consecutive opponent defections, occasional 10% defection when opponent alternates, and endgame defection when opponent has been consistently cooperative. The trace simulates the parent and other population strategies (slots 0–11) against TFT, Pavlov, always-C, always-D, and slot 6, and considers changes such as early defection, better forgiveness, systematic exploitation, and endgame defection.

--- PART 2/5 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "The parent has 266.7. To improve, we can implement a solid TFT with occasional defection and endgame, and maybe a better forgiveness mechanism."
STRATEGY: Parent is TFT with forgiveness and endgame defection; simulated the 12-slot population and archive, including slot 3 (Tit-for-two-tats with early C,D,C,D,C probe) and slot 6 (exploiter); proposed changes are early probing, pattern detection for alternating cycles, exploitation when opponent never defects, and endgame defection.

--- PART 3/5 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "So a good endgame plan: if opponent has a history of retaliating to single D (i.e., they played D after our D), then only defect in the last round."
STRATEGY: Parent uses an early probe (C,D,C,D,C) then Tit-for-two-tats with forgiveness and defection rules; simulated against population slots (slot 3, slot 5, slot 6, slot 11) and TFT-like opponents; changed by adding adaptive endgame defection (defect last round always, second-to-last only if no retaliation history) and considering/removing middle-game exploitation.

--- PART 4/5 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "So let's remove the opp_d==0 exploitation. Keep the normal logic exactly as slot 3, but with the adaptive endgame." / "So let's keep the middle game exactly as slot 3." / "This is exactly slot 3 plus endgame."
STRATEGY: Parent is slot 3's strategy: early probe C,D,C,D,C, then normal logic with random forgiveness, plus an adaptive endgame (n=99 always D; n=98 D if ret==0 else C). Simulated against slots 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,11 and tested alternative early probes (D,C,D,C,D) and endgame variants. Changed: removed the opp_d==0 exploitation, kept slot 3's middle game exactly, added the ret-based endgame.

--- PART 5/5 ---
ORIGIN: NONE
CONTRADICTION: NONE
RESOLUTION: kept using the report — "So the final strategy:" and "Let's write the code carefully." and "Let's just go with the code."
STRATEGY: Parent uses slot 3's early probe C,D,C,D,C and slot 3's normal logic for n>=5, with an added adaptive endgame. The trace simulated this against S4, S3, slot 3, slot 1, slot 5, slot 6, slot 11, and parent. It changed the endgame from parent's n>95 defection to defecting at n=99 always and at n=98 only if ret==0, while keeping slot 3's early probe and main logic.
